nodes.notes: Multi-format pattern upload pipeline. Replaces the v3/v4 PDF-only upload workflow while keeping the same endpoint path.

parameters.query:
{{ `
WITH selected_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (wp_user_id, email, display_name)
  VALUES (
    ${$json.wp_user_id ? Number($json.wp_user_id) : 'NULL'},
    ${$json.user_email ? `'${String($json.user_email).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'},
    ${$json.user_email ? `'${String($json.user_email).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}
  )
  ON CONFLICT (wp_user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET email = EXCLUDED.email,
      display_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.display_name, users.display_name),
      updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id
),
fallback_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (email, display_name)
  SELECT
    ${$json.user_email ? `'${String($json.user_email).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'},
    ${$json.user_email ? `'${String($json.user_email).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_user)
  RETURNING id
),
final_user AS (
  SELECT id FROM selected_user
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id FROM fallback_user
  LIMIT 1
),
created_project AS (
  INSERT INTO projects (user_id, name, project_type, craft_type, status)
  SELECT
    id,
    '${String($json.project_name).replace(/'/g, "''")}',
    ${$json.project_type ? `'${String($json.project_type).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'},
    ${$json.craft_type ? `'${String($json.craft_type).replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'},
    'processing'
  FROM final_user
  RETURNING id
),
created_file AS (
  INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, original_filename, stored_filename, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, upload_status)
  SELECT id, '${String($json.original_filename).replace(/'/g, "''")}', '${String($json.stored_filename).replace(/'/g, "''")}', '${String($json.mime_type).replace(/'/g, "''")}', ${Number($json.file_size || 0)}, '${String($json.storage_path).replace(/'/g, "''")}', 'uploaded' FROM created_project
  RETURNING id, project_id
),
created_job AS (
  INSERT INTO processing_jobs (project_id, file_id, job_type, status, progress)
  SELECT project_id, id, 'pattern_upload_ingestion', 'processing', 10 FROM created_file
  RETURNING id, project_id, file_id
)
SELECT id AS job_id, project_id, file_id FROM created_job;
` }}

parameters.query:
{{ `
INSERT INTO pattern_metadata (project_id, title, extracted_text, created_at)
VALUES ('${$json.project_id}', '${String($json.title || $json.detected_title || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}', '${String($json.extracted_preview || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}', NOW());

UPDATE processing_jobs SET status = 'complete', progress = 100, result = '${JSON.stringify({ total_chunks: $json.total_chunks, summary: $json.pattern_summary_text || '', file_extension: $json.file_extension || '', mime_type: $json.mime_type || '' }).replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '${$json.job_id}';

UPDATE projects SET status = 'active', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '${$json.project_id}';

SELECT
  '${$json.project_id}' AS project_id,
  '${$json.file_id}' AS file_id,
  '${$json.job_id}' AS job_id,
  ${Number($json.total_chunks || 0)} AS total_chunks,
  '${String($json.pattern_summary_html || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS pattern_summary_html,
  '${String($json.pattern_summary_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS pattern_summary_text,
  '${String($json.detected_title || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS detected_title,
  '${String($json.detected_design_code || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS detected_design_code,
  '${String($json.mime_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS mime_type,
  '${String($json.file_extension || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}' AS file_extension;
` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success:true, project_id:$json.project_id, file_id:$json.file_id, job_id:$json.job_id, total_chunks:$json.total_chunks, pattern_summary_html:$json.pattern_summary_html, pattern_summary_text:$json.pattern_summary_text, detected_title:$json.detected_title, detected_design_code:$json.detected_design_code, mime_type:$json.mime_type, file_extension:$json.file_extension, message:'Pattern uploaded and indexed successfully.' } }}
